title: Anemony
summary: ANEM'ONY, n. [Gr. from wind.] Wind-flower; a genus of plants of numerous species. Some of the species are cultivated in gardens, of which their double flowers are among the most elegant ornaments. Sea

inlines.v: ANEM'ONY, n. [Gr. from wind.] Wind-flower; a genus of plants of numerous species. Some of the species are cultivated in gardens, of which their double flowers are among the most elegant ornaments. Sea Anemone. See Animal Flower.
